description: This file contains implementation details for autograd metadata management in PyTorch, including functions for handling forward gradients, view interactions, and metadata consistency checks within the autograd system.

classes.name: AutogradMeta
classes.description: Class managing autograd metadata for tensors, including forward gradients and view relationships.

classes.name: ForwardGrad
classes.description: Class representing the forward gradient associated with a tensor in autograd.

classes.name: DifferentiableViewMeta
classes.description: Class managing metadata for tensors that are views, including forward view info.

methods.name: has_same_meta
methods.description: Checks if two variables have the same metadata, including storage properties and strides.

methods.name: set_fw_grad
methods.description: Sets or updates the forward gradient for a tensor, handling view relationships and in-place updates.

methods.name: fw_grad
methods.description: Retrieves the forward gradient for a tensor at a specific level, considering view relationships.
